profile_text.body:
Midjourney is a for-profit independent research lab founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as exploring new mediums of thought and expanding the imaginative powers of the human species, with plans to release projects organized around themes of imagination, coordination, reflection, beauty, and human flourishing.

The company's primary AI product is Midjourney, an image generation tool categorized under image and graphic design, available at its main website. IP provenance has been flagged as relevant to the product, a detail that is reflected in the company's legal situation.

Midjourney faces significant copyright litigation, with 161 tracked legal exposure points in California. Active cases include EVOX Production LLC v. Midjourney, Inc., Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc. v. Midjourney, Inc., and Disney Enterprises, Inc. and Universal v. Midjourney, Inc., all filed in the Central District of California. Midjourney is also named as a defendant in Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd., filed in the Northern District of California, a case that also involves other AI companies.
